full_details: In the morning the garden went on a little and stopped. You did not rule the act off, and you did not give the lines to Thomas Pope or to anyone else. In the afternoon you played the Knave. Richard Cowley came through the dry place once. He apologised to nobody. Your eight lines held. It was not a triumph, and the book was not mended. At home you wrote that down, and you wrote that Kemp has not been shown the king.
one_sentence: In the morning the garden went on a little, and in the afternoon your eight lines held while Cowley came through once.
title: Cowley through the dry place once
